title: Black Lagoon — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Black Lagoon shows exactly where that breaks. Black Lagoon (stylized in all caps) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Rei Hiroe. It has been published in Shogakukan's seinen manga magazine Monthly Sunday Gene-X since April 2002, with its chapters collected in 14 tankōbon volumes as of August 2026.

The selfish-gene reading of Black Lagoon makes it less romantic and far more precise. Black Lagoon 2: Ballad of the Sinful Wizard (ブラック・ラグーン 2 罪深き魔術師の哀歌, Burakku Ragūn Tsu Tsumibukaki Uizādo no Barādo) was published on January 18, 2011. An illustration book, titled Onslaught: Black Lagoon Illustrations, was released by Shogakukan on August 19, 2021.
